description: The pie chart represents the domain distribution of the AttrEval-GenSearch test set across 12 categories. The chart is divided into 12 slices, each representing a distinct domain. The slices, in order of size, are: AI/NLP Research (blue, 24.3%), Econ. & Fin. (light blue, 18.4%), Game&Anime (orange, 8.2%), Law (pink, 8.2%), History (yellow, 6.7%), Science (purple, 6.7%), Business (red, 5.9%), Med & Health (green, 6.7% - although labeled as 5.5% in the key, the size matches 6.7%), Daily Life (teal, 7.1%), Pet & Animal (brown, 5.5%), Geography (dark green, 2.7%), and Math (light green, 1.2%). Percentage labels are shown outside the chart, next to each corresponding slice label, and the slices are distinguishable by their colors. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are directly connected to their respective slices. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in any particular way beyond their size.
